title: 第547章 山门震怒万仙出截教列阵迎金仙第546章 盘古幡出金灵伤杀劫迷心金仙闯
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
东海金鳌岛，碧游仙域。
四海仙涛环伺，万古云海沉浮，整座仙山常年笼罩在苍茫厚重的截天道韵之中。
自封神大劫暗流涌动以来，洪荒诸天处处杀机暗藏、博弈不休，唯有这片截教祖庭，始终保持着独有的安稳与从容。
无外界喧嚣扰世，无仙门纷争缠身，千万弟子潜心悟道、勤修功法，一派万仙来朝、道统昌盛的鼎盛气象。
此刻的金鳌岛，更是褪去了往日的肃穆，透着几分难得的松弛喜气。
碧游宫内一处清净灵坛之上，多宝道人端坐云台，神色平和，正亲自指点身前弟子修行。
身为截教大弟子、通天座下首徒，他素来沉稳持重、执掌门规、统筹教务，眼界与心性皆远超寻常内门金仙，极少亲自下场督导后辈修行。
可如今，他却放下一身琐事，耐心传道，目光之中满是期许与重视。
他身前立身之人，正是杨戬。
自被截教门人接引上山、拜入碧游门下，杨戬便彻底脱离了阐教旧日羁绊，潜心扎根截教大道。
其天赋根骨本就冠绝凡尘、远超同辈，心性坚韧、道心纯粹，历经数次洗道重修，已然挣脱了旧有功法桎梏，转修截教最为厚重霸道的力之大道。
力之大道承载开天本源、厚重无双、杀伐凛然，最是契合封神乱世的修行大势，也最能扛住天道劫火冲刷。
多宝道人凝视杨戬周身流转的厚重道纹，缓缓颔首，声线沉稳厚重：“你根基得天独厚，心性远超常人，弃旧从新、转修力道，是你最大机缘，也是我截教之幸。”
“阐教十二金仙欲寻命格契合者替劫，所求的，便是你这等先天道体、劫缘相合的顶尖苗子。可惜他们执念太深、道心狭隘，错失真玉，反被我截教先一步纳归门下。”
字字句句，皆是笃定。
此前阐教耗费心力推演天机、下山寻徒，妄图以凡人后辈替十二金仙挡劫续命，可他们穷尽天机寻觅的顶尖替劫人选，最契合命格、最能承接劫力的绝世苗子，早已稳稳扎根金鳌岛，成了截教重点栽培的核心后辈。
杨戬闻言，躬身受教，周身力道灵光愈发凝实，每一次吐纳呼吸，都牵动周遭山川灵气汇聚，道基稳固，日日精进。
金鳌岛另一侧的火云灵涧旁，同样一派热闹景象。
赵公明与罗宣两位金仙正围着一名少年弟子，互不相让，隐隐透着几分争抢之意。被二人争相传道的，正是哪吒。
哪吒身具莲花道体、火行本源，先天火脉纯净霸道、世间罕见，乃是天生的火道修行奇才，更是另一处完美契合阐教替劫命格的关键苗子。

罗宣本就执掌万火道统、精通火法神通，一眼便看中了哪吒的先天火道天赋，执意要收其为亲传弟子，倾囊相授毕生火道绝学。
可赵公明亦是眼光毒辣，深知哪吒命格特殊、劫缘深重、潜力无穷，得此一子，便是截教未来多一尊顶尖战力，说什么也不肯轻易退让。
两位老牌金仙互不相让、各执一词，争执片刻，最终索性达成共识，一同出手、双双传道，共同督导哪吒修行。
一人打磨其道基、稳固其心性，一人传授其火法、淬炼其神通，双强加持，让哪吒的修为一日千里，飞速蜕变。
岛上其余弟子远远观望，皆面露笑意。
旁人皆是一师传道，唯有哪吒、杨戬二人，得截教内门顶尖大能亲自督导，这份殊荣，纵观洪荒后辈，寥寥无几。
看似轻松平和的岛上日常，实则暗藏深意。
这一幕，直白印证了此前截教的先手布局绝非偶然。
阐教拼尽全力想要抢夺的替劫机缘、逆天苗子，早已被截教尽数收入囊中，悉心栽培、稳稳掌控。阐教的替劫生路，从根源上被彻底截断，再无半分翻盘可能。
可就在这份安稳喜乐弥漫全岛之际，异变陡生。
嗡——！
整座金鳌岛之上，无数弟子腰间悬挂的师门玉牌，近乎同时微微震颤、灵光骤亮。
content_en:
Jin'ao Island in the East China Sea, a fairyland in the blue.
The four seas are surrounded by fairy waves, and the eternal sea of ​​clouds rises and falls. The entire fairy mountain is shrouded in the vast and thick Jietian Daoyun all year round.
Since the undercurrent of the Great Tribulation of the Gods, murderous intentions have been hidden and games have been played everywhere in the ancient world. Only this ancestral home of Jiejiao has always maintained its unique stability and calmness.
There is no external noise disturbing the world, no immortal sects entangled in disputes, tens of thousands of disciples devote themselves to enlightenment and diligent cultivation of the Kung Fu, and there is a prosperous atmosphere where thousands of immortals come to the court and the Taoism flourishes.
At this moment, Jin'ao Island has lost the solemnity of the past, exuding a rare sense of relaxation and joy.
On a pure spiritual altar in Biyou Palace, Taoist Master Duobao is sitting on a cloud platform with a peaceful expression, personally instructing the disciples in front of him on their practice.
As the top disciple of Jie Jiao and the first disciple of Tongtian Seat, he has always been calm and solemn, in charge of the sect's rules and coordinating the teaching affairs. His vision and character are far beyond those of ordinary inner sect golden immortals, and he rarely personally supervises the cultivation of his juniors.
But now, he put aside all his trivial matters and preached patiently, his eyes full of expectation and attention.
The person standing in front of him was Yang Jian.
Since being led up the mountain by the disciples of Jie Jiao and becoming a disciple of Biyou, Yang Jian has completely broken away from the old fetters of Chan Jiao and devoted himself to taking root in the path of Jie Jiao.
His talent is unparalleled in the world, far superior to his peers, his mind is tenacious, and his Taoist heart is pure. After several times of cleansing and recultivation, he has broken free from the shackles of the old skills and converted to the most profound and domineering path of power in Jiejiao.
The Avenue of Power carries the origin of the Heaven, is unparalleled in thickness, and is killing and majestic. It is most in line with the general trend of spiritual practice in the troubled times of the Conferred Gods, and is also the best able to withstand the erosion of the Heavenly Dao Tribulation Fire.
Taoist Duobao stared at the thick Tao patterns flowing around Yang Jian's body, nodded slowly, and said in a calm and deep voice: "You have a unique foundation, and your mind is far beyond ordinary people. It is your greatest opportunity to abandon the old and start a new one, and to cultivate strength. It is also my luck to teach you."
"The Twelve Golden Immortals of the Interpretation and Teaching want to find someone with the right fate to replace the calamity. What they are looking for is you, the top seedling with the innate Taoist body and the calamity fate. Unfortunately, they are too obsessed with the Tao and have a narrow heart. They missed the true jade, but I intercepted the teaching and took it into my sect."
Every word and every sentence is determined.
In the past, Chanjiao spent all their efforts to deduce the secrets of heaven and go down the mountain to find disciples, hoping to use mortal children to protect the Twelve Golden Immortals and save their lives. However, they exhausted all the heavenly secrets to find the top candidate for the disaster, the most suitable person with the destiny and the best to bear the power of the disaster. The peerless seedlings have already firmly taken root in Jin'ao Island and have become the core children to be cultivated by Jiejiao.
Hearing the words, Yang Jian bowed down to receive the instruction, and the aura of strength around his body became more and more solid. Every time he exhaled and breathed out, it affected the aura of the surrounding mountains and rivers to gather together. The Taoist foundation was solid and he made progress every day.
Next to the Huoyun Lingjian on the other side of Jin'ao Island, there was also a lively scene.
The two golden immortals Zhao Gongming and Luo Xuan were surrounding a young disciple, refusing to give in to each other, and there was a hint of competition. It was Nezha who was being fought over by the two to preach.
Nezha has a lotus Tao body, the origin of fire, and an innate fire vein that is pure and domineering, rare in the world. He is a natural prodigy in the way of fire, and he is another key seedling that perfectly fits the fate of Chanjiao.
Luo Xuan was originally in charge of the Ten Thousand Fire Dao Tradition and was proficient in fire magic. He took a fancy to Nezha's innate fire talent at a glance and insisted on accepting him as his direct disciple and teaching him his lifelong fire technique.
But Zhao Gongming also has a sharp vision, and he knows very well that Nezha has a special destiny, a deep destiny, and unlimited potential. Having this son will give him a top fighting force in the future, and he will not give in easily no matter what.
The two veteran golden immortals refused to give in to each other and insisted on their own opinions. They argued for a while, and finally reached a consensus. They took action together, preached together, and jointly supervised Nezha's practice.
One person polishes his Tao foundation and stabilizes his character, and the other teaches his fire method and refines his magical powers. With the support of both, Nezha's cultivation is changing rapidly.
The other disciples on the island watched from a distance, all with smiles on their faces.
Everyone else is a disciple of the same master, but Nezha and Yang Jian are the only two who have the opportunity to be personally supervised by the top masters of the inner sect. This honor, throughout theThere are very few descendants from the prehistoric times.
The seemingly relaxed and peaceful daily life on the island actually has a hidden meaning.
This scene directly confirmed that Jie Jiao's previous layout was no accident.
The opportunities and seedlings that Chan Jiao tried his best to seize had already been collected by Jie Jiao, and they were carefully cultivated and controlled steadily. Chanjiao's way of reviving the disaster has been completely cut off from the source, and there is no chance of a comeback.
But just as this peace and joy filled the island, sudden changes occurred.
Buzz—!
On the entire Jin'ao Island, the master's jade plaques hanging on the waists of countless disciples trembled slightly and their auras suddenly brightened almost at the same time.
